evidence.sourceLabel: USFWS invasive carp eDNA sample layer
evidence.caveat: Survey non-detection is not verified absence and does not establish that the species is absent from the county. The official item documents assay and processing changes in 2014, 2015, and 2020; the retained sample dates and program documents preserve that historical-method boundary. Positive eDNA can be transported and is excluded from this negative assertion; no positive label is converted to verified presence. No detection data, field blanks, duplicate identities, invalid coordinates, offshore points, ambiguous geography, and state mismatches are ineligible.
